answer.message: Thank you for your offer. We are prepared to give you the planning security you are looking for: a binding commitment for our full annual volume over a three-year term. In return we need the price to reflect a stable long-term customer and a lead time that matches our requirements. We believe this gives both sides a reliable basis for allocating your capacity.
